stories.headline: Canada proposes closer European Union ties to protect trade and sovereignty
stories.body:
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney delivered a speech to the European Parliament in Strasbourg [c4]. He called for closer cooperation on defence and energy between Canada and the European Union [c4].

Carney told European lawmakers that closer ties would protect Canada [c2]. He said deeper cooperation would stop any external power from controlling Canadian markets [c2]. He added that it would prevent outside powers from undermining Canadian sovereignty [c2]. Earlier in 2026, Carney spoke at the World Economic Forum [c3]. He urged middle powers to act together [c3]. He said smaller nations must limit coercive actions by more powerful nations [c3].

Carney proposed new ways to connect citizens across the Atlantic Ocean [c5]. He suggested deepening people-to-people ties with the European Union [c5]. This proposal would allow young people to live, work, and study on either side of the Atlantic [c5].

Many Canadians share historical links with Europe. According to Canada's 2021 census, over half of the Canadian population reported having European origins [c8]. Public opinion also shows support for closer cooperation. An Abacus Data survey conducted before the speech measured public views [c9]. It found that 80 percent of Canadians support deepening strategic cooperation with the European Union [c9].

Economic experts view the proposed relationship positively. Fabian Zuleeg, Chief Economist at the European Policy Center, spoke about the economic relationship [c1]. Zuleeg said the partnership between Canada and the European Union is a classic win-win situation [c1].

Trade with the United States remains central to the Canadian economy. Up to 72 percent of Canadian exports are destined for the United States [c7].

The proposal faces legal hurdles in Europe. The European Union currently does not have an associate member status [c6]. Creating such a status would require approval from all 27 member states [c6].

Political opponents in Canada raised doubts about the initiative. Conservative Member of Parliament Adam Chambers questioned the prime minister's speech [c10]. Chambers asked whether Carney's proposal was a concrete plan or just words and vibes [c10].

vocab.meaning: the authority of a state to govern itself
involving two countries or groups
using force or threats to compel action

stories.headline: UN experts report reasonable grounds US committed war crimes in Iran strikes
stories.body:
United Nations experts reported reasonable grounds to believe the US committed war crimes in military strikes in Iran [c11]. Two strikes on February 28 killed at least 177 civilians [c11].

Local authorities said a Tomahawk missile hit a primary school in Minab [c12]. The strike killed at least 156 people, including 120 children [c12]. Iranian state media reported that 168 people died in the school strike [c18]. UN investigators concluded the school was the intended target rather than collateral damage [c13]. The Pentagon completed an internal investigation into the bombing following reports that targeting data was outdated [c21].

In Lamerd, local officials said missile strikes dispersing tungsten pellets over a sports complex killed at least 21 civilians [c14]. US Central Command denied conducting strikes in Lamerd on that date [c15]. White House spokeswoman Anna Kelly dismissed the UN report [c23]. She said the body had spouted unserious nonsense for decades [c23].

The report also stated Iranian security forces committed crimes against humanity during recent protest crackdowns [c16]. Iranian figures reported 3,038 killed, but UN experts believe the true count is higher [c22]. Over 70 people in Iran face imminent risk of execution [c20].

vocab.meaning: about to happen very soon
unintended damage accompanying a primary objective

stories.headline: Russia begins parliamentary elections during ongoing war in Ukraine
stories.body:
Russian citizens began voting in parliamentary elections for all 450 seats in the State Duma [c24, c25]. Voting opened in the Far East regions of Kamchatka and Chukotka [c25]. President Vladimir Putin delivered a televised address calling on citizens to demonstrate national unity [c26]. He urged voters to show support for Russian troops [c26].

Russia's Supreme Court removed the anti-war Yabloko party from the national ballot [c27]. Polling by independent firm ExtremeScan showed 18 percent of Russians would have voted for Yabloko [c28, c30]. ExtremeScan also found 60 percent of Russians believe the war in Ukraine negatively affects daily life [c28]. According to the Levada Center, six in ten Russians favor peace negotiations with Ukraine [c29].

Exiled opposition leaders Yulia Navalnaya and Maxim Katz asked citizens to vote against United Russia [c31]. Opposition politician Ilya Yashin urged anti-war voters to gather at polling stations at noon on September 20 [c32]. Nearly 200 veterans of the war in Ukraine are running as candidates [c33]. Meanwhile, election monitor Grigory Melkonyants was sentenced to five years in prison in 2025 [c34].

vocab.meaning: relating to an elected legislature or parliament

stories.headline: US grants entry visas for Iranian president to attend UN meeting
stories.body:
The United States State Department announced that Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian will receive an entry visa [c41]. Pezeshkian and a core delegation will attend the UN General Assembly in New York [c41]. State Department spokesman Tommy Pigott said the Iranian delegation will face travel restrictions [c43]. The US also banned the delegation from purchasing luxury goods [c43].

The US government barred Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas from receiving an entry visa for the second straight year [c42]. US President Donald Trump said he is approaching a big decision on the next phase of the Iran war [c37]. Trump is scheduled to meet leaders from six Gulf nations at the UN headquarters [c38].

Tensions in the region remain high. Iran's Revolutionary Guard struck a Togo-flagged oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz [c35]. The strait handles 20 percent of global seaborne energy transit [c44]. Drone attacks on pumping stations temporarily shut down Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline [c40]. Fighting in Yemen has displaced over 100,000 people inside the country [c39].

vocab.meaning: a group of people chosen to represent a country or organization

stories.headline: US State Department approves $24 billion F-35 fighter jet deal for Saudi Arabia
stories.body:
The United States State Department notified Congress of a proposed $24.3 billion military sale to Saudi Arabia [c45]. The package includes 48 F-35 fighter jets and 49 engines made by Pratt & Whitney [c45, c51].

US Representative Raja Krishnamoorthi opposed the deal due to intelligence warnings [c47]. He warned that China could gain access to sensitive technology [c47]. A US Justice Department case previously involved a Chinese national stealing sensitive military documents from United Technologies [c53].

In July 2026, the US approved a $1.96 billion deal for precision rocket guidance equipment to Saudi Arabia [c50]. The US State Department approved another $5 billion sale of over 10,000 bombs in September 2026 [c49]. Saudi Arabia also signed a mutual defence agreement called the Mecca Agreement with Pakistan and Turkiye [c48].

Conflict along Saudi borders continues. Houthi forces in Yemen claimed they shot down a Saudi F-15 fighter jet [c46]. In Taif province, debris from an intercepted Houthi drone killed one person and injured two others [c52].

vocab.meaning: secret information gathered about an enemy or foreign nation

stories.headline: Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson resigns after election defeat
stories.body:
Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson submitted his resignation after left-leaning opposition parties won a parliamentary majority [c54, c59]. Preliminary counts showed the left-leaning opposition bloc secured 176 seats in the 349-seat Riksdag [c54, c60]. The opposition won by a margin of 50,359 votes over the ruling Tidö coalition [c55].

Social Democrats leader Magdalena Andersson invited three other parties to start initial coalition talks [c56]. She reached out to the Left, Centre, and Green parties [c56]. Left Party leader Nooshi Dadgostar stated voters gave a clear mandate for change [c58].

The right-wing bloc led by Kristersson secured 173 seats [c60]. The far-right Sweden Democrats lost votes in a general election for the first time [c57]. The party dropped from second-biggest to third-biggest [c57].

The Speaker of the Riksdag will consult party leaders before nominating a candidate for prime minister [c61]. Forming a government took 37 days after the 2022 election and 134 days after the 2018 election [c62].

vocab.meaning: a temporary alliance of political parties forming a government
the authority given by voters to a political party to carry out policies

stories.headline: US Federal Reserve raises benchmark interest rates for first time since 2023
stories.body:
The United States Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 0.25 percentage points on September 16, 2026 [c63]. The decision marks the Fed's first interest rate increase in three years [c63]. The unanimous vote set the benchmark federal funds rate between 3.75% and 4% [c66]. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said inflation is too high and has been for too long [c69].

Projections showed 16 out of 18 policymakers expect rates to end 2026 above current levels [c67]. President Donald Trump criticized the central bank board [c70]. Trump called the board hostile and political for raising rates [c70]. Major US banks JPMorgan Chase, KeyCorp, and BNY raised prime lending rates to 7% [c71].

In Singapore, banks increased fixed home loan rates ahead of the Fed decision [c65]. Floating-rate loans in Singapore use the Singapore Overnight Rate Average as a benchmark [c64].

High energy costs are causing economic pressures worldwide. Soaring fuel prices sparked public protests in Syria, the Philippines, and Indonesia [c68]. Brent crude oil futures fell to $104.82 per barrel on news of possible Saudi oil shipments [c72]. The Bank of England kept its interest rate unchanged [c73].

vocab.meaning: a standard or reference point used for comparison
fully agreed upon by everyone involved

stories.headline: Biologists identify new wild cat species in cloud forests of Bolivia
stories.body:
Biologists named a new wild cat species discovered in Bolivia's Yungas cloud forest [c74]. The cat is formally named Leopardus tilcayo and locally called tilcayo [c74]. The tilcayo measures about 18 inches in length and weighs about 3 pounds [c75].

DNA analysis of 38 specimens showed South American tiger cats consist of five distinct species [c76]. Genetic evidence indicates the tilcayo lineage separated from other tiger cats 1.4 million years ago [c77]. Biologists also identified a distinct tiger cat subspecies in Peru's Yungas region [c78]. The tilcayo is the first newly described living cat species identified since 1923 [c80].

Bolivian biologist Paola Nogales-Ascarrunz examined a wild kitten brought to a wildlife sanctuary in 2016 [c79]. A 10-year-old male tilcayo lives at the Senda Verde sanctuary near La Paz [c81]. Local camera traps show the cat is active at night [c82]. Scat samples revealed the species eats small rodents [c83]. The International Union for Conservation of Nature classifies tiger cats as vulnerable [c84].

vocab.meaning: direct descent from an ancestor or earlier form
active mainly during the night

stories.headline: US House approves bill allowing up to 100% tariffs on Indian and Chinese energy imports from Russia
stories.body:
The United States House of Representatives passed legislation granting US President Donald Trump authority to impose high tariffs [c85]. The bill allows tariffs of up to 100% on countries buying Russian oil and gas, including India and China [c85]. The bill is titled the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act 2026 [c89]. The House approved the measure by a vote of 262 to 159 after it cleared the Senate [c86].

Under the draft law, 100% tariffs could apply to the five largest importers of Russian oil or gas [c93]. The duties would target countries that knowingly continue purchases 30 days after the bill becomes law [c93].

Indian officials defended their energy purchases. India's Ambassador to the US Vinay Mohan Kwatra said energy is a vital strategic necessity for 1.4 billion Indians [c87]. Kwatra called energy the foundation of India's development [c87]. India imports over 85% of its crude oil and about half of its natural gas [c88].

Trade relations between the US and India have faced past friction. In April 2025, the US announced a 26% tariff on several Indian imports [c94]. The US paused that rate for 90 days before setting a temporary 10% duty [c94].

China also criticized the US legislation. Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said China opposes unilateral sanctions that lack a UN Security Council mandate [c90]. Chinese President Xi Jinping is scheduled to visit Washington on September 24-25 for a summit with Trump [c91]. US and Chinese officials are consulting on a tariff reduction framework covering $30 billion in products from each side [c92].

vocab.meaning: taxes imposed by a government on imported goods
penalties applied against a nation to force compliance with laws
action taken by one nation without agreement from others

stories.headline: Election Commission freezes Trinamool Congress name and symbol following party split
stories.body:
The Election Commission of India froze the All India Trinamool Congress name and party symbol [c95]. The interim order came after rival party factions split [c95]. The order prevents both groups from using the flowers and grass symbol [c95]. The Election Commission issued the decision under Paragraph 15 of the 1968 Election Symbols Order [c98].

The freezing order applies to upcoming elections. The commission barred both factions from using the party name and symbol for the October 6 parliamentary by-election in Assam's Nagaon seat [c100]. West Bengal will also hold assembly by-elections in Rejinagar and Nandigram on October 6 [c96]. The Election Commission instructed both factions to submit three new group names and symbol choices from the free symbols list [c101].

Party leaders reacted strongly to the decision. Trinamool Congress MP Kalyan Banerjee accused Ritabrata Banerjee of triggering the dispute because he was not named opposition leader [c99]. Congress General Secretary K.C. Venugopal criticized the order [c97]. Venugopal called the decision a bullet through the heart of Indian democracy [c97].

vocab.meaning: temporary or serving in the time between two events
small dissenting groups within a larger political party

stories.headline: Indian government establishes fee rules for digital UPI transactions above Rs 2,000
stories.body:
The Indian government announced that a 0.4% Merchant Discount Rate will apply to UPI transactions above Rs 2,000 starting October 15 [c102]. Small merchants earning up to Rs 1 lakh per month through UPI QR codes will be exempt [c109]. Finance Ministry sources estimate that transactions above Rs 2,000 make up about 4% of total UPI transaction volume [c106].

The National Payments Corporation of India set a flat Rs 5 rate per transaction above Rs 2,000 for specific sectors [c104]. These sectors include railways, telecom, insurance, and fuel [c104]. The Payments Council of India confirmed the flat Rs 5 fee applies to fuel purchases [c105]. The Department of Financial Services said 5% of fee collections will fund a dedicated fund to promote UPI adoption among small merchants [c103].

Industry figures held differing views on the fee structure. BharatPe CEO Nalin Negi said UPI will remain free for consumers while building a sustainable ecosystem [c107]. Former BharatPe CEO Ashneer Grover claimed merchants will pass the cost on to customers [c108]. Meanwhile, the Department of Financial Services rejected claims of US influence [c110]. Official rules restrict UPI credit transactions to RuPay cards [c110].

vocab.meaning: free from an obligation or requirement that applies to others
able to be maintained over a long period
